high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a news article from CNN Climate, dated 3 days ago, as indicated at the bottom of the post. The headline reads: "Manatees are dying in droves and it could be only a matter of years left to save them." The article discusses the alarming decline in manatee populations due to environmental stress, specifically mentioning that manatees are dying off at one of the highest rates in recent history.
